en: A monochrome winter street scene showing early 20th‑century military or transport trucks parked in a row beside a large, ornate stone building with arched windows and classical detailing. Many people in long coats and military-style uniforms stand or walk along the snowy, unpaved street. Bare trees and other multi‑story European-style buildings line the background, and a tall telegraph pole rises near the trucks. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
